description: This file defines the 'GrainExtensionNotInstalledException' class, a custom exception used in the Orleans runtime to signal that a grain extension method was invoked on a grain where that extension is not installed. It includes various constructors for different initialization scenarios and uses serialization attributes.

classes.name: GrainExtensionNotInstalledException
classes.description: A sealed custom exception class indicating a grain extension is not installed.

methods.name: GrainExtensionNotInstalledException()
methods.description: Default constructor with a fixed message.

methods.name: GrainExtensionNotInstalledException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor accepting a custom message and an inner exception.
